evidence: Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and adds the setprunelock and listprunelocks RPC commands in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp.
rationale: Adds new RPCs that enable external software and wallets to manage prune locks and prevent blocks from being pruned during downtime or before rescans. Reviewers noted this provides a meaningful interface improvement for wallets leveraging Bitcoin Core on pruned nodes.
